cards.claim: The 1978 NCAA Division I-A football season was the first season of Division I-A football.
cards.quote: 1978 NCAA Division I-A football season The 1978 NCAA Division I-A football season was the first season of Division I-A football; Division I-A was created in 1978 when Division I was subdivided into Division I-A and I-AA for football only.

cards.claim: The 1978 NCAA Division III football season was part of college football organized at the Division III level.
cards.quote: 1978 NCAA Division III football season The 1978 NCAA Division III football season, part of college football in the United States organized by the National Collegiate Athletic Association at the Division III level, began in August 1978, and concluded with the NCAA Division III Football Championship in December 1978 at Garrett-Harrison Stadium in Phenix City, Alabama.
